Lemma
[Minimal geodesics in a closed locally convex set] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0441, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0442, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0443 1. apph:H.15\group Locally convex subsets If $C$ is connected, closed, and locally convex in a complete Riemannian manifold, then every $x,y\in C$ are joined by a smooth ambient geodesic in $C$ of length \[ d_C(x,y)=\inf \{ \operatorname {L}(\beta ):\beta \subset C,\ \beta (0)=x,\ \beta (1)=y\} . \]
